description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the AccessFlowStateMachineDao class within the OrangeHRM Core module. It includes various test cases to verify CRUD operations, workflow state retrieval, and role-based access functions related to workflow state management.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the AccessFlowStateMachineDao data access object, including methods for CRUD operations and workflow state validation within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the AccessFlowStateMachineDao instance and populates test fixtures from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForExistingAction
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allowed actions for an existing action in the workflow.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActionsForNonExistingAction
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allowed actions for a non-existing action, expecting null.

methods.name: testGetNextStateForExistingState
methods.description: Verifies the retrieval of the next state given a valid current state.

methods.name: testGetNextStateForInvalidState
methods.description: Verifies that null is returned for an invalid current state.

methods.name: testGetActionableStates
methods.description: Checks the retrieval of actionable states based on current state, role, and actions.

methods.name: testSaveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Tests saving a new workflow state machine record and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion of a workflow state machine record for a specific state.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Retrieves all workflow state machine records for a specific workflow type.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecordsNullWorkflow
methods.description: Ensures the retrieval returns an empty array for non-existent workflow types.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if an action is allowed within a specific workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedForNonEntry
methods.description: Verifies that an action is not allowed when current state does not permit it.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsExisting
methods.description: Tests fetching allowed workflow items for a specific state and role.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsAllStates
methods.description: Retrieves all workflow items for a role across all states.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItemsNotExisting
methods.description: Verifies that no workflow items are returned for non-existent criteria.

methods.name: testGetWorkflowItemsByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Tests fetching specific workflow items based on state, action, and role.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Verifies deletion of workflow records associated with a specific role.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRoleAllWorkflows
methods.description: Tests deletion of all workflow records for a role across all workflows.

methods.name: testHandleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Tests updating workflow records when a user role is renamed.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemIdsForRole
methods.description: Helper method to fetch workflow record IDs for a given role in a specific workflow.
